short_bio: Film director of the Dark Knight trilogy, Inception, Interstellar and Oppenheimer.
biography:
Christopher Nolan was born in London and studied English literature at University College London, where he began making films. His first feature was Following (1998), and Memento (2000) brought him wide notice.

He directed the Batman films Batman Begins (2005), The Dark Knight (2008) and The Dark Knight Rises (2012), then Inception (2010), Interstellar (2014), Dunkirk (2017) and Tenet (2020). His wife Emma Thomas produces his films.

Oppenheimer (2023) won seven Academy Awards including Best Picture and his first for Best Director.
